items.q: The interviewee discusses Fletcher Henderson in the context of Don Redmon's career and Jean Goldkette's band, stating 'Don Redmon at that time was playing with Fletcher Henderson' and 'Jean Goldkette... sent and got him, Fletcher, to come to Detroit'. ctx.x: And then McKinney didn't play anymore? He just managed?

No, he was just the manager. And as the story goes with that band, they used to go up to Manitou Beach, Michigan, every summer to [Clark's Lake] and play. When Jean Goldkette Gene Galkit heard the band up there he liked what he heard, so he was getting ready to build this million dollar ballroom called the Graystone in Detroit.
